spans.s: उन्मज्जन n. (op. to मज्जन) Coming out of water.

उन्मत्त (I) a. (f. त्ता) 1. Insane, frantic; 2. drunk, intoxicated; 3. possessed by an evil spirit, M.iii.161. (Mitākshara on Yaj.ii.132 explains उन्मत्त by वातपित्तश्लेष्मसंनिपातग्रहसंभवनोपसृष्टः. Also See M.ix.79.)
उन्मत्त (II) m. The dhattūra plant.

उन्मत्त (I) a. (f. त्ता) 1. Insane, frantic; 2. drunk, intoxicated; 3. possessed by an evil spirit, M.iii.161. (Mitākshara on Yaj.ii.132 explains उन्मत्त by वातपित्तश्लेष्मसंनिपातग्रहसंभवनोपसृष्टः. Also See M.ix.79.)
उन्मत्त-गंग n. the name of a country.
उन्मत्त-प्रलपित (I) a. spoken in drunkenness or madness.
उन्मत्त-प्रलपित (II) n. the word of a madman.
उन्मथन n. 1. Throwing off or down; 2. killing, slaughter, R.vii.52.
उन्मद (I) a. (f. दा) 1. Mad; 2. drunk; 3. extravagant, intoxicated, R.ii.9, xvi.54; 4. causing intoxication, मधुकरांगनया मुहुरुन्मदध्वनिभूता निभृताक्षरमुज्जगे Sis.vi.20.
उन्मद (II) m. 1. Insanity; 2. intoxication.
उन्मद (I) a. (f. दा) 1. Mad; 2. drunk; 3. extravagant, intoxicated, R.ii.9, xvi.54; 4. causing intoxication, मधुकरांगनया मुहुरुन्मदध्वनिभूता निभृताक्षरमुज्जगे Sis.vi.20.

उन्माद (I) m. 1. Madness, extravagance; 2. lunacy considered as a disease of the mind (in medicine); 3. madness. considered as one of the 33 subordinate feelings (in rhetoric); it is thus defined- चित्तसंमोह उन्मादः कामशोकभयादिभिः S.D.iii.; 4. bloom, e.g. उन्मादं वीक्ष्य पद्मानाम्.
उन्माद (II) a. (f. दा) See उन्मद I.
उन्माद (II) a. (f. दा) See उन्मद I.
उन्मदन a. (f. ना) Inflamed with love, K.S.v.55.
उन्मदन a. (f. ना) Inflamed with love, K.S.v.55.
उन्मादन n. One of the five arrows of the god of love.
उन्मदिष्णु a. 1. Mad; 2. intoxicated.
उन्मनस् a. (f. स्का) 1. Excited or disturbed in mind, R.xi.22; 2. repining for a lost or departed friend.
उन्मनस् a. (f. स्का) 1. Excited or disturbed in mind, R.xi.22; 2. repining for a lost or departed friend.
उन्मनस् a. (f. स्का) 1. Excited or disturbed in mind, R.xi.22; 2. repining for a lost or departed friend.
उन्मनस् a. (f. स्का) 1. Excited or disturbed in mind, R.xi.22; 2. repining for a lost or departed friend.
उन्मंथ m. 1. Agitation; 2. killing, slaughter.
उन्मंथन n. 1. Shaking, agitating; 2. hurting, killing.
उन्मयूख a. (f. खा) Shining, radiant, R.xvi.69.
उन्मयूख a. (f. खा) Shining, radiant, R.xvi.69.
उन्मर्दन n. 1. Rubbing; 2. fragrant essence used for rubbing.
उन्माथ m. 1. Shaking, agitating; 2. killing, slaughter; 3. a snare, a trap.
उन्मान n. 1. Measuring upwards; 2. a measure of size or quantity; 3. price.
उन्मार्ग m. 1. A wrong road; 2. deviation from the right road (lit.), improper conduct, evil course (fig.), नित्यमुन्मार्गगामिनाम् Panch.i.
उन्मार्जन n. Rubbing, wiping off.
उन्मिति f. The same as उन्मान q.v.
उन्मिश्र a. (f. श्रा) Mixed with.
उन्मिश्र a. (f. श्रा) Mixed with.
उन्मिषित a. (f. ता) 1. Opened, as an eye; 2. blown, as a lotus.
उन्मिषित a. (f. ता) 1. Opened, as an eye; 2. blown, as a lotus.
उन्मीन n. 1. Winking; 2. becoming visible; 3. blowing, expanding.
उन्मील m. 1. Opening the eyes; 2. blowing, expanding.
उन्मीलन n. 1. Opening the eyes; 2. blowing, expanding.

उन्मुख a. (f. खी) 1. Raising the face, अद्रेः शृंगं हरति पवनः किंस्विदित्युन्मुखीभिः Megh.i.14, ii.37, R.i.39, xi.26; 2. eager, waiting for, expecting, R.vi.21, xi.23, xii.26, K.S.vi.34; 3. near to, on the point of, ready, prepared for, R.xvi.9, iii.12); 4. sounding, making a sound, K.S.vi.2.

उन्मुख a. (f. खी) 1. Raising the face, अद्रेः शृंगं हरति पवनः किंस्विदित्युन्मुखीभिः Megh.i.14, ii.37, R.i.39, xi.26; 2. eager, waiting for, expecting, R.vi.21, xi.23, xii.26, K.S.vi.34; 3. near to, on the point of, ready, prepared for, R.xvi.9, iii.12); 4. sounding, making a sound, K.S.vi.2.
उन्मुखर a. (f. रा) Loud-sounding, noisy.
उन्मुखर a. (f. रा) Loud-sounding, noisy.
उन्मुद्र a. (f. द्रा) 1. Unsealed; 2. opened, blown, as a flower.
उन्मुद्र a. (f. द्रा) 1. Unsealed; 2. opened, blown, as a flower.
उन्मूलन n. 1. Rooting out, eradicating, पादपोन्मूलनशक्ति रंहः R.ii.34; 2. destroying.
उन्मेदा f. Corpulence, fatness.

उन्मेष m. 1. Opening the eyes; 2. blowing, blossoming, उन्मेषं यो मम न सहते जातिवैरी निशायाम् K.Pr.x., K.S.ii.33; 3. awakening, rising, springing up, Sant.S.iii.13; 4. flash, brilliancy, खद्योतालीविलसितनिभां विद्युदुन्मेषदृष्टिम् Megh.ii.18.

उन्मेषण n. 1. Opening the eyes; 2. blowing, blossoming, उन्मेषं यो मम न सहते जातिवैरी निशायाम् K.Pr.x., K.S.ii.33; 3. awakening, rising, springing up, Sant.S.iii.13; 4. flash, brilliancy, खद्योतालीविलसितनिभां विद्युदुन्मेषदृष्टिम् Megh.ii.18.
उन्मोचन n. Unfastening, loosening.
